title: Ritual Tablets with extra Favour rerolls
summary: Roll Ritual Tablets for the 'of Prayers' suffix (Ritual Altars allow rerolling Favours 1–3 additional times), Divine it to +3, and sell to Ritual Omen farmers. Corrupting never makes +4; sanctifying a rare one is the creator's gamble for it.

budget.why: Chaos and Annulment rerolls on rare tablets, then Divine Orbs to push the suffix to +3.
budget.build_needs: None for the rolling; Ritual Tablets come from ordinary maps.

claim.note: Our reading of the method against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: No combat: the method is rolling in the stash and selling.

claim.note: Not rated: the build scale measures map content, and this method has none.

complexity.why: The complexity scale is written for map setups, not for rolling at the stash.

claim.note: Not rated: no step of the scale describes a rolling loop.

durability.why_it_works: The 'of Prayers' suffix gives every Ritual Altar in the map 1–3 more Favour rerolls, which is how Ritual farmers find Omens.
breaks_when: Rerolls stop being the way to find Omens

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.
Base RitualAugment: 'Adds Ritual Altars to a Map', 10 uses.

target_mods.text: Ritual Altars in Map allow rerolling Favours (1–3) additional times

claim.note: Suffix 'of Prayers' (RePoE TowerRitualAdditionalReroll). trade2 files the stat under its one-value wording 'an additional time', which RePoE's tablet stat descriptions give the same stat.

roll_steps.action: Chaos Orbs on a rare Ritual Tablet until the 'of Prayers' suffix lands; on a magic one you can Annul a mod and add another.

claim.note: Creator method (Diztoh, 2026-07-09): chaos spam at 0:33 and 7:43; annul and re-add on magic bases at 9:40.

roll_steps.action: Divine Orb until the suffix reads +3, before any corruption. A +1 roll shows no number ('an additional time').

claim.note: A Divine Orb randomises values; RePoE gives the value-1 roll the wording 'an additional time'. An Ancient Infuser corrupts the tablet and never raises a value. Diztoh (3:31) Divines to +3.

roll_steps.action: Optional gamble on a rare +3: with an Omen of Sanctification active, a Divine Orb sanctifies the tablet; each value is multiplied by 78–122% and the tablet is then locked, so +3 can become +4 or +2.

claim.note: poe2db: the omen makes the next Divine Orb on a Rare item Sanctify it. The 78–122% range and the +3 → +4 result are Diztoh's (2026-07-09, 4:51–6:12 and 14:00), not checked against game data.

demand.why: Ritual Omen farms reroll Favours at every altar, and since 0.5.5 each Ritual Tablet beyond the first adds an altar and more Wisps, so farmers slot several.

claim.note: The extra altar per tablet is in the 0.5.5 patch notes; the demand is creator advice (Diztoh 2026-07-09). Whether reroll suffixes on several tablets add up is unverified.

risks: Corrupting a +3 tablet does not make it +4: an Ancient Infuser never raises a value and can destroy the tablet or change its type.
Sanctifying is a gamble that can lower the value, and a sanctified tablet cannot be changed again.
Whether the reroll suffix stacks across several tablets in one map is unverified.
Tablets are not on the currency exchange: price on the trade site with the Search link.
